scientific_integrity: Analytical finite-selector reduction and perturbation proof with exact rational three-point certificates. Finite numerical tests supplement but do not prove universal results. Bibliographic uniqueness remains a limitation.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge finite stars with equal leaf masses, arbitrary hub mass, strong L2 only. Eventual exact large-hub selector threshold exists but its optimum is not evaluated; examples establish at least two transitions, not an exhaustive phase diagram. Uniform-mass and complete-graph endpoint facts are prior art.
title: Mass-ratio phase changes for centered \(L^2\) maximal averages on weighted stars
